principles.interpretation: Zero vocabulary drill. Entire session = real-world career setup. Students engaged because stakes were real. Class can be 100% career action and still be the best English lesson.
Recognize fear-based motivation (parental pressure) without shaming. Channel into immediate tangible action. Quan promised mother to find job this week → LinkedIn + website in one sitting.
Quan's AI pipeline (sketch→ChatGPT→Gemini) = using AI as creative amplifier, not replacement. Company accused of copying = proof the workflow works.
Same internship experience. They didn't teach me anything vs I am learning real-world workflows. Framing on CV changes everything.
Start Fiverr/Upwork/LinkedIn before you need them. Compounding applies to reputation platforms.
Students talked for 70 minutes about their lives, careers, fears. Zero grammar correction. Maximum engagement.
Setting students up on Notion = experiencing the ecosystem. Free trial → dependency → retention.
Teaching relationship converts to business relationship (Quan → Roblox 3D modeling). Revenue attribution through trust.
